flags.why: The adjective belongs mainly to Southern Vietnamese, as documented in [Thanh Niên](https://thanhnien.vn/lat-leo-chu-nghia-cu-lan-va-cu-lan-lua-185916850.htm).
The literal word for corncob is Southern usage, as recorded in [Wiktionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/c%C3%B9i_b%E1%BA%AFp).
This is an old colloquial term for spoon, so the Northern tag alone misleadingly presents it as current everyday vocabulary; see [Wiktionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/c%C3%B9i_d%C3%ACa).
The example defines what syntax studies instead of showing the term in use.
